reason: A WeChat channel integration for DeepSeek Harness that forwards messages to a DSH agent, preserves conversation sessions, and returns responses through WeChat; the README explicitly documents file-reading and shell-command capabilities.

summaries.zh: 通过微信连接 DeepSeek Harness，让用户在手机微信中与 DSH agent 对话并使用其工作区能力。
summaries.en: Connects WeChat to DeepSeek Harness so users can chat with a DSH agent and use its workspace capabilities from the WeChat app.

capabilities: Connects WeChat messages to a DSH agent through the iLink channel
Maintains a persistent session context for each WeChat conversation
Relays agent interactions that may read files and run shell commands in the configured workspace
Uses external WeChat and model credential services
